product_one_liner.value: Incorta gives enterprise business users and data teams a governed platform to analyze live operational data and build AI-powered applications and workflows without complex ETL.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link or public pricing page was found on the company website; prospects are directed to a demo. Separately, its AWS Marketplace listing publishes Standard and Premium pricing: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-4vnhp7q2eyppg

eng_blog.notes: Engineering@Incorta includes Mostafa Elganainy’s posts on Incorta’s off-heap memory implementation and Direct Data Mapping architecture.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No qualifying AI, ML or data-science title was found. AI-related responsibilities appear in openings titled Principle Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer, which do not meet the requested title test.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Azure OpenAI; Meta Llama 3.1 through Incorta Nexus
model_provider.notes: These are publicly documented supported or configured providers/models, not a claim that every deployment uses all of them.

compliance_certs.notes: Incorta Intelligence explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification. Other cited pages claim adherence to ISO 27001, HIPAA and GDPR; these are public compliance claims, not independently verified certificates. PCI DSS is omitted because the security terms only mention possible audit-report scopes.

last_funding.notes: Latest publicly announced round found. A conflicting database entry dates the same $120 million Series D to April 2025; the company’s dated announcement establishes June 23, 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: No later announced financing was found in the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; the latest official funding announcement is June 23, 2021.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Sales Development Representative - USA is publicly listed.

launched_6mo.notes: Incorta Intelligence became generally available June 30, 2026, including AI applications, Smart Agent and workflow automation, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page and dated appointment announcements were checked, but start dates for the full leadership roster and departures could not be established. Ragy Eleish’s October 7, 2025 appointment falls outside the window; Noha Rizk’s appointment was December 4, 2024, despite a later directory update.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly requires managing prospect interactions in Salesforce and Outreach; Gong and Apollo appear as sales-tool experience requirements, which are weaker evidence of deployment.
